facts.text: Forty cups out to the curb and not one came back short. Best coffee on the block.
facts.why: No opened source has Rotzinger ordering or praising coffee. Sources show him negotiating with the clown during the bank robbery.
facts.fix: Best coffee on the block. I was busy that morning, negotiating with a clown.

facts.why: Guest check built on the same forty cups of coffee idea, which no opened source supports.

vibe.verdict: A solid bar across from the bank with the clown, the exact fare gag and the BQE signs, but the coffee gag for Rotzinger is made up.
